title_en: 3+1+2 apartment for sale in front of Delijorgji!
description_en: Apartment 3+1+2 for sale in front of Delijorgji! The apartment is located in one of the most dynamic areas of Tirana, in front of the Delijorgji complex, in a new building with an elevator and 2 floors of underground parking. Positioned on the 8th floor (not the last) and facing east, the apartment has a perfect floor plan. It is organized in; - with entrance corridor, - large living room, kitchen and dining area, - 3 bedrooms, one of which has a separate wardrobe. - 2 toilets. - The main balcony is accessible from the living room and offers an impressive view of the city and Dajti mountain. - Meanwhile, the second balcony is located in the matrimonial room. - gross area 140 m/2 - net area 124m/2 - The apartment is invested with quality materials, including an internal thermal insulation system, and is sold furnished as in the photo. - Along with the apartment, a closed garage on the -1st floor, invested and with parking space for 3 vehicles, is offered at an extra cost, - The property has mortgage documentation.
